runtime_notes: V8.3.4 is the full installer baseline because the embedded Windows runtime includes ReportLab, arabic-reshaper and python-bidi.
Do not use direct_files to upgrade pre-V8.3.4 installations to V8.3.4 because direct_files cannot replace the embedded EXE runtime dependencies.
Future source-only updates after V8.3.4 may use direct_files when no embedded-runtime dependency or executable change is required.
